name: Finhay
description: Access Vietnam's financial markets through Finhay Securities' infrastructure. Get stock prices across HOSE, HNX, and UPCOM, dive into company financials: income statements, balance sheets, cash flow..., and track macroeconomic indicators, FX rates, gold, and commodity prices. Monitor your portfolio performance, review order history, and analyze holdings by sector or asset class. Built for investors who want to research, analyze, and act on Vietnam's market. All through conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Finhay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Finhay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fhsc.com.vn/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Finhay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finhay lists 37 MCP tools, including get_account_summary, get_asset_summary, get_bank_interest_rates, get_commodity_prices, get_company_overview, get_economic_calendar, get_financial_analysis, get_financial_statement, get_fund_benchmark_growth, get_fund_benchmark_nav, get_fund_companies, and get_fund_nav_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Finhay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Finhay in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Finhay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Finhay is developed by Finhay Securities Joint Stock Company. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
